tabHelp.workspace: Renaming a category syncs frontmatter; deleted optional categories are not recreated by ensure.
tabHelp.ai: Saving with an empty key preserves the existing value; click clear to delete.
tabHelp.skills: Unchecking only hides from the Agent catalog.
tabHelp.tools: Tools run in a background process, no extra Dock icon. AI writes still go through the workspace service.
tabHelp.plugins: Connectors are configured in the extensions group; third-party toggles need no restart.

tabHelp.topmind-ingest.settings: Default: only Markdown output; optionally keep originals to 99-Archive.
tabHelp.topmind-weread.settings: Sync budget and category affect where files land.

general.appearanceDesc: Theme and sidebar defaults; drag widths are auto-remembered
general.openAiPanelDesc: Only affects next launch default state
general.workspaceBrowseDesc: Sidebar tree and delivery/archive list file visibility · Expand state is remembered
general.closeWindowDesc: On Windows/Linux, hiding keeps a tray icon; on macOS, goes to dock. Tray can capture/quit.
general.editorReadingDesc: Shared by edit & preview · Toolbar "Aa" for quick adjust · ⌘S save · ⌘⌥F focus
general.paperDesc: Only affects edit & preview canvas, not global theme
general.paperSepia: Sepia · Warm brown for long reads
general.autoSaveDesc: Debounced disk write for dirty content
general.wordWrapDesc: Off = horizontal scroll for long lines
general.inlineAiAutoPopupDesc: Off = trigger via toolbar ✨ or context menu only
general.tabModeSingle: Single tab (one file at a time)
general.writebackDesc: Plain language: auto-save or ask before save · also switchable from AI panel
general.writebackHelpAuto: Auto-save + backup · AI may write files; full overwrite/delete go to archive (recoverable).
general.writebackHelpConfirm: Ask before save · AI write tools stay registered; results enter the pending-write strip for accept/reject before disk. Suggestions may be prepared automatically; important memory writes need your confirm.
general.autoPrepareSuggestionsDesc: When the workspace is ready, scan tidy-up candidates (Inbox / stale topics / memory). With a model configured this may call AI for extract/promote; never writes silently — you confirm each apply. Off = manual refresh only (saves tokens).
general.autoMaintainTodosDesc: When the workspace is ready and AI is available, extract/update personal todos from the stream (memory/todo.md). Default off to avoid background token use; or trigger manually via Stream ✨ / Todo panel.
general.clipBridgeDescStopped: Local HTTP bridge for browser extension to write to Inbox
general.clipBridgeHelp: Token is for extension Authorization; do not commit to repo.
general.clipBridgeEnableOn: Extension can POST to local port
general.clipDownloadImagesDesc: On bridge write, download remote images to Inbox/images/ and rewrite as relative paths (selection/highlights excluded)
general.clipSteps1: Load the extension directory browser-extension/ in your browser (developer mode)
general.clipSteps2: Enable Clip Bridge here, click copy Token
general.clipSteps3: Paste Token in extension settings → test Bridge; or authorize a local workspace dir (Desktop not required)
general.captureTrayDesc: Notes · links · docs · global sticky · system tray
general.captureTrayHelp: ⌘N in-app overlay; ⌘⇧N global sticky; tray icon for one-click capture (essential on Windows when close-to-hide)
general.globalShortcutDesc: Capture from anywhere, even outside the app
general.trayIconDesc: Recommended: one-click show / capture / ingest / quit (essential when close-to-hide)
general.floatOnTopDesc: Float capture window stays above other apps
general.smartPasteDesc: Detect clipboard files / probe attachments when opening sticky
general.closeFloatOnSaveDesc: Close the sticky window after successful write; off = keep for rapid notes
general.floatNote: Sticky blank? Update to this version: now uses opaque load + loadFile query param. Dev mode requires full npm run desktop:dev.
general.shortcutsHelp: Workspace-global; some combos are not intercepted inside inputs

skills.skillFirstDesc: Route → load_skill → tools; pin in panel or use /note
skills.extraDirsDesc: Merged into Agent catalog; same-name skill overrides built-in
skills.extraDirsHelp: "Add dir" only references path; "Install local" copies to Desktop skills-extra with receipt.
skills.noReceipt: No receipt in managed dir (use "Install local" to write)
skills.noExtraDirs: No extension directories. "Add dir" to reference a pack, or "Install local" to copy with receipt.
skills.catalogDesc: Unchecking only hides from Agent catalog; disk files preserved
skills.noSkills: No skills found. Run from monorepo in dev mode.
skills.errNotPack: Selected directory is not a skills pack (needs SKILL.md or topmind-pack.json)
skills.errNotPackShort: Selected directory is not a skills pack
skills.addConfirmDesc: No files copied; only adds path to Agent search list. Same-name skill overrides built-in.
skills.installConfirmDesc: Copies to Desktop managed dir skills-extra with install receipt. Same-name skills overwritten.

workspace.firstLevelCatsHelp: Added categories write to config; hidden ones remove from sidebar. System roles are locked.
workspace.rebuildHint: Role · visibility · rename all editable in cards below
workspace.renameDesc: Updates directory name, config, and frontmatter category field
workspace.memoryDesc: Where AI understanding, context hints and personal status are saved
workspace.createCategorySlotHelp: Leave slot empty for auto-assignment; loose stream role will set flat-default.
workspace.currentDesc: Configured in topmind.yaml · Hidden categories don't appear in sidebar
workspace.streamPackingDesc: How quick notes are stored by default
workspace.switchWorkspaceDesc: Select/Create will reload · Close returns to Landing without deleting data
workspace.recentWorkspacesDesc: × Only removes from list, doesn't delete from disk

companions.desc: Detect agent hosts · browsers · Obsidian; install / upgrade / uninstall

companions.agentsDesc: Claude Code / Codex / Hermes / OpenCode / CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy (best-effort)
companions.installAllTooltip: Install to all detected agent hosts
companions.upgradeAllTooltip: Upgrade all installed agent host Skills
companions.clipHelp: Desktop never silently installs to the Chrome Web Store or browser profiles. Only unpacks to a managed local folder.
companions.clipGuidedInstructions: Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) → enable Developer mode → Load unpacked → pick the folder below.
companions.obsidianDesc: Install into the current workspace vault (requires .obsidian)
companions.obsidianHelp: Plugin id is topmind-stream. If this workspace is not an Obsidian vault, open the folder in Obsidian first, or copy the plugin manually.
companions.pluginNotInstalled: Plugin not installed in this vault
companions.vaultReady: Can install into current workspace vault
companions.vaultNotReady: Current workspace has no .obsidian (not a vault, or not opened in Obsidian yet)
companions.vaultNotReadyHint: Open this workspace folder in Obsidian first (Open vault → Open folder as vault) to create the .obsidian directory, then install the plugin.
companions.obsidianReloadHint: Reload in Obsidian after install: Settings → Community plugins → toggle off/on topmind-stream

env.quarantineDesc: Run this when macOS says the app is "damaged and can't be opened"

manage.autoCheckUpdatesDesc: Checks Desktop / Skills / Clip / Obsidian for new versions. When updates are available, a badge appears in the status bar — click to open this page.
manage.modulesDesc: Agent Skills · Clip extension · Obsidian plugin (detect / install / upgrade / uninstall)

about.updateDesc: Desktop / Skills / Clip / Obsidian — each surface checked independently against remote GitHub releases
about.updateHelp: Checks public latest.json first (CDN, no API needed), then also queries GitHub API to catch surface-specific releases (obsidian-v*, skills-v*) that latest.json misses. API is non-blocking: if rate-limited or blocked, falls back to latest.json. Skills, Clip extension, and Obsidian plugin are all bundled with the engine.
about.checkFailedHint: Occurs when both public latest.json and network are unreachable. Click the external link to manually view Releases, or configure a system proxy and retry.
about.clickToCheck: Click check to fetch online versions (latest.json + GitHub API, no token needed)
about.healthDesc: Desktop native inspection + bundled UTR diagnostics (subprocess adds no extra Dock icon)
about.footerHelp: Local-first · Graphite · Tiptap · AI SDK · 1 RPC · 3 Store

plugins.descLoaded: Built-in plugins run continuously · Connectors and 3rd party plugins are toggleable
plugins.helpLoaded: 3rd party permissions are declared in the plugin manifest; basic capabilities only if undeclared. Preview risks before installing.
plugins.helpInstall: Preview permissions and risk before installing. Install trusted sources only. Restorable from trash after uninstall.
plugins.emptyThirdPartyHint: No 3rd party plugins. Use 'From Folder / Zip' to install, or 'Generate Sample' to test.
plugins.uninstallModalConfirm: Move '{{id}}' to plugins/.trash (can be manually restored)? Workspace contents won't be deleted.
plugins.replacesWarning: Will overwrite existing plugin with same name{{version}}, old version moved to .trash
plugins.trustModel: Trust model = user-installed: plugins share the app process. Permissions are soft-gated, not sandboxed. Only install from trusted sources.
